playbooks.name: Scoundrel
echoes: Narrate a flashback to a job that went spectacularly wrong. What were you trying to steal, who was counting on you, and what unexpected consequence followed you afterward?
Narrate a time when someone placed their trust in you, even though you had every reason to let them down. What did you do with that trust?
Narrate a scene in which you came closer than ever to losing everything. What choice did you make when the usual rules no longer mattered?
Narrate the moment you made a promise that could change your life or someone else's. Why did you make it and what would fulfilling it demand?
What line do you insist you would never cross? Narrate a time when you were tempted to cross that line. What was at stake and what ultimately stopped you?
Narrate a moment when you found something that made you consider giving up the next job, the next score, or the next escape. Why did you stay?

playbooks.name: Ace
echoes: Narrate a flight when you pushed a ship beyond what its design or crew thought possible. What drove you and what did the experience teach you?
Who do you most want to impress? Narrate a moment when you had the chance to prove yourself to this person.
What is the greatest thing you have ever flown? Narrate a scene from your time piloting this craft. Show what made it extraordinary and what happened that you still remember.
Narrate the flight, mission, or maneuver that went wrong. What were you trying to accomplish, what did you lose, and what do you tell yourself about it now?
Narrate a moment when you chose to take a flight that others considered suicidal. What were you trying to save, prove, or reach?
Narrate your first encounter with a pilot whose skill surpassed yours. How did they demonstrate it and how did you react?

playbooks.name: Warrior
echoes: What are you willing to kill for? Narrate a moment when someone or something you valued was threatened, and you had to decide how far you would go to protect it.
Who are you sworn to protect? Narrate the moment you accepted responsibility for this person or group. What happened that made you take on that burden?
Narrate a time when keeping your word, following your code, or doing what you believed was right came at a personal cost.
Who taught you how to fight? Narrate a scene from your training with this person. How did they teach you to fight, and what did they teach you about when not to?
Narrate an encounter with someone who embodied everything you fear becoming. What did they do and why would you never do the same?
Narrate a moment when you considered walking away from violence for good. What ultimately kept you fighting—or made you stop?

playbooks.name: Operative
echoes: Narrate the moment you learned, uncovered, or became responsible for a secret that could destroy you. Who else knows and what happened to keep it hidden?
Who knows the real you? Narrate a scene in which you let this person see past your cover, your profession, or your carefully constructed identity. Why did you trust them with that knowledge?
What identity have you left behind? Narrate a scene from the life you once lived under another name. What did that identity allow you to do and why were you forced to abandon it?
Who taught you that trust is dangerous? Narrate the moment this person taught you that lesson. What did it cost you, and how did it change the way you work?
What information would you kill to obtain? Narrate a past operation in which you came close to obtaining this information. What did you risk? Why does it still matter?
What truth are you afraid to discover? Narrate a moment when you came close to uncovering this truth but chose to stop, turn away, or destroy the evidence.

playbooks.name: Leader
echoes: Who follows you, and why? Narrate the moment this person or group first chose to follow you. What do they see in you? What did you promise them?
Narrate a time when someone placed their future in your hands. What did they need from you and what did you have to sacrifice to provide it?
What responsibility would you never abandon? Narrate the moment you accepted this responsibility. Who would suffer if you walked away?
Narrate a moment when you faced a choice between your own future and the needs of those who follow you. What did you choose and what did it cost?
Narrate a scene in which you witnessed a leader behave in a way you despise. How did their actions affect your own leadership style?
What would you sacrifice yourself to protect? Narrate a moment when you came close to making that sacrifice. Who tried to stop you?

playbooks.name: Force User
echoes: When did you first feel the Force? Narrate the first moment you experienced something you could not explain. What happened around you and how did you understand—or misunderstand—it?
Who taught you what the Force means? Narrate a scene in which this person explained or demonstrated their understanding of the Force. What did you take away from the lesson?
Narrate a moment when you felt the Force answer you in a way that frightened you. What did you do with that power? What did you fear that it revealed?
What do you believe the Force wants from you? Narrate a vision, encounter, or strange coincidence that shaped this belief. How has it changed your path?
Narrate a moment when the Force showed you something about another person that you wish you had never known. What did you choose to do with that knowledge?

Narrate a scene in which someone you cared about—or something you desperately wanted—was threatened in a way that made you touch the Dark Side for the first time. Did you resist or give in to your hatred?

playbooks.name: Diplomat
echoes: Narrate a negotiation that went disastrously wrong. What did you want, what did the other side demand, and what consequence still follows you?
Who taught you how to read a room? Narrate a moment when their lesson changed the outcome of a conversation.
What relationship have you risked everything to preserve? Narrate the moment it was tested and what you chose.
Describe a time when you used your words to prevent violence. What did you promise, and what did that promise cost?
Who considers you a rival? Narrate the moment your competition became personal. What do they believe you took from them?
Narrate a moment when you discovered that peace could be more dangerous than conflict. What did you do with that knowledge?
